title: Staking v2
body:
We have the [old staking contract](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/wiki/24.-Smart-Contracts#masterchef-v21) (which still works) where users are able to stake 3CRV LP tokens and get rewards in UBQ tokens. The old staking contract has some issues:
1. It uses 3CRV LP tokens from the old `uAD/3CRV` pool. We've redeployed our stable coin so now we're using [UUSD](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/wiki/24.-Smart-Contracts#ubiquitydollartoken) instead of the deprecated [uAD](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/wiki/08.-uAD) token.
2. The old staking contract is unaudited
3. There's [this](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/issues/939) issue with the old staking contract

It makes sense to reimplement staking so that users were able to stake `UUSD/LUSD` [LP tokens](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/wiki/24.-Smart-Contracts#lusduusd) and get `UBQ` rewards. This way contributors have an incentive to keep `UUSD` in the `UUSD/LUSD` pool instead of swapping `UUSD` for a more liquid asset.

We've already ported staking to [this](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/6f3b3e02dcc342bc39f7f4cae3112a51cbfc8d58/packages/contracts/src/dollar/facets/StakingFacet.sol) diamond facet but we've never tested how it really works.

What should be done:
1. Refactor [LibStaking](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/6f3b3e02dcc342bc39f7f4cae3112a51cbfc8d58/packages/contracts/src/dollar/libraries/LibStaking.sol) to match the original [MaterChef](https://github.com/sushi-labs/sushiswap/blob/271458b558afa6fdfd3e46b8eef5ee6618b60f9d/contracts/MasterChef.sol) implementation
2. Cover `LibStaking` with unit tests
3. Prepare on-chain [migrations](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/tree/development/packages/contracts/migrations)

The next step would be to audit the updated code and deploy to production.
